result.topic_en: The page gives the cotangent of the inclination between two directions relative to a ternary quadratic form and its adjoint, and states that the complex values of the orthographic projections of three equal, mutually perpendicular lines satisfy aa+bb+cc=0, with a general parametrization and a numerical example.
result.transcription:
170.
Ist die ternäre Grundform $\begin{pmatrix}a,b,c\\0,d,0\end{pmatrix}$, Adiuncta $\begin{pmatrix}A,B,C\\0,D,0\end{pmatrix}$
so ist Neigung $(1,0,0)$ zu $(p,q,r)$ $= i$
$\cot i = \frac{Ap+Dr}{\sqrt{(ABqq+(AC-DD)rr)}} = \frac{cp-dr}{\sqrt{\frac{(cqq+brr)(ac-dd)}{b}}}$
Ist $d=D=0$
so ist [-cotg i-] $\cot i$ [-=-] $= \frac{p}{\sqrt{(\frac{B}{A}qq+\frac{C}{A}rr)}}$

Sind die complexen Werthe der orthographischen Projectionen
von drei gleich langen und unter einander senkrechten geraden
$a, b, c$
so ist
$aa+bb+cc=0$
allgemein kann man setzen
$a = pp+qq$
$b = 2ipq$
$c = ipp-iqq$

methods.what: Cotangent of the angle between the direction (1,0,0) and (p,q,r) with respect to a ternary quadratic form (a,b,c;0,d,0) with adjoint (A,B,C;0,D,0)
Special case d=D=0 of the inclination formula
The complex numbers representing the orthographic projections of three equal, mutually perpendicular segments satisfy a sum-of-squares relation
General parametrization of solutions of aa+bb+cc=0
Numerical example of complex projections satisfying the relation

items.english: If the complex values of the orthographic projections of three straight lines that are equally long and mutually perpendicular are a, b, c, then aa+bb+cc=0.
